❮ Math Methods

ThemultiplyExact()method multiplies two integers and throws an exception if the result causes an overflow. This prevents incorrect results that can occur from multiplying really large numbers.

One of the following:

### Code Snippets

```
Example
Multiply integers using
multiplyExact()
:
System.out.println(Math.multiplyExact(96000, 1200));
System.out.println(Math.multiplyExact(-460, 95));
Try it Yourself »
```
